title: lee-ai. (^-^)ノ avatar-cursor
excerpt: A live AI cursor that talks, points, frames products, and operates your website for your visitors. Two-line integration.
content_html:
(your website's shop assistant)

Your always-available AI shopper —
a live cursor that shows your visitors around.

github.com/avatar-cursor

Memo: npx github:eliasschwalme/avatar-cursor
Or, add two lines to your site

It talks. It points. It frames the right product in marching red dashes.
It writes the price math on a sticky note. It never lies about what it did.
open source · keys stay server-side · works on any website
→ join the Discord · follow on X

← psst — watch her work. Two minutes.
